description: "Housing market trends in [ZIP]" / "median home price in [area]" / "is [ZIP] heating up or cooling" / "sales volume in [neighborhood]" — aggregated real estate market trends by ZIP. Returns average/median sale price, sales volume, and price changes monthly / quarterly / yearly across a date range. Use for market-direction questions before pulling individual addresses.

geoid.description: A 5-digit ZIP code ("33158"). ATTOM's own "ZI"-prefixed form ("ZI33158") is also accepted; a bare ZIP is prefixed for you.

interval.description: Time interval: monthly, quarterly, or yearly

name: attom_sales_trend

outputSchema.description: Market sales trend response from ATTOM API
